description: Fetch the reviews of a Google Maps place via SerpAPI. Provide exactly one of place_id, data_id or data_cid — all come from google_maps_search or google_local_search results. A digit-only id (the `place_id` that google_local_search returns is a Google CID) is accepted in any of the three fields and resolved to the Maps data_id automatically via one place lookup. Returns reviews (author, rating, text, date) plus the topics you can filter by. Paginate with next_page_token from the previous response.

data_cid.description: Google CID of the place — the digit-only `place_id` google_local_search returns. Resolved to the Maps data_id via one place lookup. Provide exactly one of place_id, data_id or data_cid.

data_id.description: Google Maps data_id of the place ('0x…:0x…' from google_maps_search). Provide exactly one of place_id, data_id or data_cid.

next_page_token.description: Pagination token from the previous response, to fetch the next page of reviews.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

num.description: Number of reviews per page, 1-20 — only honoured together with next_page_token, topic_id or query; the initial page always returns 8 and the parameter is dropped there.

place_id.description: Google Maps place_id of the place ('ChIJ…' from google_maps_search). A digit-only value is treated as a Google CID and resolved automatically. Provide exactly one of place_id, data_id or data_cid.

query.description: Filter/search reviews by free text. Mutually exclusive with topic_id.

topic_id.description: Filter reviews by a topic id (from a prior response). Mutually exclusive with query.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_maps_reviews
title: Get Google Maps Reviews (SerpAPI)
